Pill shape: `border-radius: 50px` - Soft bg: `background:#f8f9fa` - Subtle: `border:1px solid #e8e8e8` - Focus: `box-shadow:0 0 0 3px ${primaryColor}15` - Input padding: `14px 20px` **Button:** Change from flat square-right to: - Pill-right: `border-radius:0 50px 50px 0` - Shadow: `box-shadow:0 2px 8px ${primaryColor}25` - Hover: add transform translateY(-1px) and deeper shadow - Uppercase: `text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700` - Padding: `14px 28px` **Result card:** Change from left-border accent to: - Remove border-left, add full border: `border:1px solid ${color}18;border-radius:14px` - Softer background: `${color}08` - Better shadow: `box-shadow:0 2px 8px ${color}08` - Spring animation: change keyframe to `cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)` - Layout change: flex with `justify-content:space-between` (text left, emoji right) **Meta items:** Better spacing - Add `padding:8px 0` per item - Separator: `.zcc-meta + .zcc-meta{border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05);padding-top:10px;margin-top:2px}` - Icon color: `color:${primaryColor};opacity:0.8` instead of inheriting - Font: `font-size:13.5px` **COD badge:** Change from plain text to pill - `display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:${successColor}10;border:1px solid ${successColor}20;border-radius:20px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600` **Waitlist form:** Modern card-within-card - `font-size:16px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.01em` - Icon circle: `width:32px;height:32px` with gradient bg `linear-gradient(135deg,${primaryColor}18,${primaryColor}08)` - Add bottom separator: `padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);margin-bottom:16px` **Add new keyframes:** - Upgrade `zcc-slide-in` to use `cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)` (spring overshoot) - Add `@keyframes zcc-scale-in{from{transform:scale(0.92);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}` - Add `@keyframes zcc-pulse-ring{0%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.5}50%{transform:scale(1.2);opacity:0}100%{transform:scale(1.2);opacity:0}}` ### 2. `WidgetPreview` component — HTML structure changes **Success state — "Delivering to" confirmed view (like competitor image 5):** When `previewState === "success"`, instead of showing the search bar, show: ```tsx
✅ Delivering to 10001 Change
``` Add CSS for `.zcc-confirmed-header`: `display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 16px;background:${successColor}06;border:1px solid ${successColor}15;border-radius:12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500` Add CSS for `.zcc-change-link`: `margin-left:auto;color:${primaryColor};font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600` **Error state — show zip in input + ✗ on button:** When error/notfound, show the search bar but with a filled-in value "380007" and button shows "CHECK ✗": ```tsx ``` Add CSS for `.zcc-btn--error`: `background:${errorColor}10;color:${errorColor};font-weight:700` **Success result — emoji on right side + bold delivery date:** Replace the SVG checkIcon with emoji layout.
